programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for a compelling episode titled Victory in Jesus, featuring powerful reenactments of divine interventions that changed lives forever. Hear the story of Andy, whose midnight cable hack led him to a life-altering encounter with God. Lourdes, in San Juan, Puerto Rico, found 3ABN when she was at her lowest point, contemplating suicide, and heard a message that changed everything. And Frank, on the brink of ending his life, turned to 3ABN for comfort and found hope through a message from John Carter. Tune in for this heart-touching episode that showcases God's incredible power to save, heal, and transform even in the darkest moments.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an inspiring episode titled Saved to Share, featuring Dan’s incredible transformation. Raised in the Christian Church, Dan struggled with a distorted view of God, leading him into a life of drugs and alcohol. After a stroke and open-heart surgery, he began changing his lifestyle, seeking a closer relationship with God. Through a local radio station broadcasting 3ABN programming, Dan discovered the Seventh-day Adventist Church and began studying the Bible. As his faith deepened, he experienced a life-changing rebirth, which led to a new diet, new perspective, and a passion for sharing Jesus with others. Tune in to hear how 3ABN played a pivotal role in saving Dan’ s life and transforming him into a powerful witness for Christ.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an emotional episode titled Through the Valley, featuring Pauletta’s heartbreaking yet hopeful journey. As a rebellious teenager, Pauletta faced unimaginable loss, including the tragic murder of her son and later, the suicide of her younger son. Struggling with grief, she prayed for change and embarked on a transformative journey, driving to a new life. Along the way, a bird’s extraordinary behavior led her to feel God's presence and guidance. Arriving in Fort Worth, Pauletta discovered 3ABN and began watching its life-changing programs. Through the support of a local church and Bible studies, Pauletta's faith was restored, and she found peace and healing. Tune in to hear how God led her through the darkest valley and into His loving embrace.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an inspiring episode titled Willing to Follow, featuring Arlena’s journey of faith. Raised in a congregational church, Arlena’s life took a detour into the 1960s rock-and-roll and drug culture. After a divorce and move, she began seeking spiritual fulfillment, asking God for guidance. Her journey led her to watch 3ABN and Better Life TV, where she was drawn in by the music and the powerful message of the Fourth Commandment. After meeting an older couple at the doctor's office, Arlena began attending Sabbath services and was eventually baptized. Tune in to hear how Arlena’s search for truth led her to a loving church family and a deeper relationship with God.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to Colorado to explore the spectacular mountains, streams, pine forest, diverse wildlife, and lush vegetation of Rocky Mountain National Park. He’ll explore how mountains were made during the global Flood by Catastrophic Plate Tectonics, then eroded as the flood waters spilled into the seas. Noah shares about the evidence for this massive erosion and wasting since the flood waters receded. He also explores how other geologic sites like Great Sand Dunes National Park and Devils Tower were built in relation to the formation and erosion of the Rockies.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to Colorado to explore the spectacular mountains, streams, pine forest, diverse wildlife, and lush vegetation of Rocky Mountain National Park. He’ll explore how mountains were made during the global Flood by Catastrophic Plate Tectonics, then eroded as the flood waters spilled into the seas. Noah shares about the evidence for this massive erosion and wasting since the flood waters receded. He also explores how other geologic sites like Great Sand Dunes National Park and Devils Tower were built in relation to the formation and erosion of the Rockies.

programme.title: Salvación en Señales y Símbolos
programme.desc: El programa “Salvación en Señales y Símbolos” tiene como propósito educar al interesado en entender el Apocalipsis. Romper cualquier duda o barreras que mantenga a lector alejado, intimidado, o tenga cualquier predisposición en contra de las enseñanzas en el Apocalipsis. La visión de las 7 Trompetas han tenido variadas interpretaciones pero este estudio cuidadoso nos lleva a la realidad considerando la interpretación más razonable de las representaciones de esta escena de juicios de parte de Dios. Vemos que nos lleva al Santuario por los muebles allí mencionados para poder entender. Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best

Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

programme.title: Facing the Giants
programme.desc: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.","large":"Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

programme.title: Wild America
programme.desc: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.","large":"The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.","large":"Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: A golden ticket, a memento handed down from Houdini, puts a boy in the middle of a Hollywood superstar's lavish and secretive world.","large":"Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.","large":"Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.","large":"An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.","large":"After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.","large":"A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.","large":"Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. programme.title: The Master of Disguise
programme.desc: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.","large":"Pistachio Disguisey, a genial waiter at his father Fabrizio's Italian restaurant, possesses an uncanny knack for mimicry. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest.

programme.title: Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: A tragic accident causes a young equestrian (Avery Arendes) to lose her sight and her ability to connect with anyone or anything, until a miniature horse named Apple is trained to be her companion and surrogate eyes.

programme.title: Ice Castles
programme.desc: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future.

programme.title: Places in the Heart
programme.desc: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm in the 1930s Texas.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: Two Montana boys become different men (Craig Sheffer, Brad Pitt) under the influence of fly-fishing and their minister father (Tom Skerritt).","large":"The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly-fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: The almost mythical ability of a middle-aged baseball player rockets a major-league team toward the 1939 pennant.","large":"On the way to a tryout with the Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: The Lubbock, Texas, rock 'n' roller (Gary Busey) becomes a star with the Crickets (Don Stroud, Charles Martin Smith), then dies in a 1959 plane crash at age 22.","large":"A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies.

programme.desc: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

programme.title: Let's Do It Again
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, composer Gary Stuart (Ray Milland) and his wife, Connie (Jane Wyman), have an argument over her alleged affair with Courtney Craig (Tom Helmore). The Stuarts agree to get divorced, and each tries to move on to a new love: Gary with socialite Deborah Randolph (Karin Booth) and Connie with businessman Frank McGraw (Aldo Ray). programme.title: The Doctor Takes a Wife

programme.title: Paula
programme.desc: After her second miscarriage, Paula Rogers (Loretta Young) learns she is sterile. On the way to a reception for her professor husband, John (Kent Smith), a distraught Paula accidentally hits an orphan (Tommy Rettig) with her car. Thinking Paula is drunk, farmer Raymond Bascom (Will Wright) takes the boy to the hospital. Unwilling to confess her role in the hit-and-run for fear of derailing John's career, Paula volunteers at the hospital and helps Davey recover without admitting her guilt.

programme.title: Gidget
programme.desc: Diminutive teenager Francie Lawrence (Sandra Dee) has a bunch of boy-crazy friends, but she couldn't care less about boys. That is, until she goes to the beach one day and meets surfer Jeffrey Moondoggie Matthews (James Darren) and his friends, including Burt The Big Kahuna Vail (Cliff Robertson). Now, Francie, whom the boys call Gidget -- short for girl midget -- wants to learn how to surf, so she buys a used board and dives into the sunny world of Southern California surfing fever.

programme.title: Anchor 2017: The Hebrew Religious Calendar
programme.sub-title: The Feast of Dedica & Messiah’S Birth
programme.desc: Before Jesus came to this earth, He sat down with His Father and planned the seven successive steps that He would take in the plan of salvation. programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.desc: A '41 Chevy rolls in for a trunk-lid fix, but things go south quickly.

programme.desc: Dave and the crew swap the chassis of a 1955 Chevrolet Nomad.

programme.desc: A show in Stockton wants Dave to be a judge and to present a special award.

programme.desc: A '63 Corvette gets an LSX engine, a larger transmission and new paint.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The crew stretches a '62 Corvette and makes some other improvements.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Vinnie Massaro is back looking to build the biggest, baddest Mopar ever.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Metal work on the '67 Coronet is done, so now it's on to the paint booth.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: For years Mike has wanted to build a 200-mph Cadillac, and now David has finally agreed to make it happen; they purchase a 1961 bubbletop Cadillac DeVille in Northern California; a Cadillac 500 engine wrapped inside a '73 AMC Gremlin.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Twice the Power, Half the Trucks and Leah Pritchett
programme.desc: David and Mike merge the front halves of two four-wheel-drive vehicles.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Rear-Engine Replacement: The Econorado Is Born
programme.desc: David and Mike attempt to fill the Mazdarati void with their new Econorado.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: 440 Big-Block Samurai: From the Junkyard to the Road
programme.desc: David and Steve built the Super Sammy, a junkyard-rescued Suzuki Samurai that they crammed a 440 Chrysler big-block into right where it sat in the middle of the junkyard; now they're back to find out why Suzuki never offered this engine combination.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: David and Mike consider themselves masters of burnout-ology; yet they have never actually entered a burnout competition until now; they take a rusted-out '76 Camaro and set out across Texas to show how to scientifically get the best burnouts.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: David and Mike take a 1964 Ford Galaxie 500 XL that absolutely needed to be rescued; after a few miles, the car begins to smoke worse than any car in the history of Roadkill.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: David and Mike find beaters under $3K; it's a four-vehicle shootout with Chevy vs. Ford, truck vs. car, and old vs. newer; Freiburger chose a 2006 Crown Vic and a 1999 Chevy S-10; Finnegan went vintage with a 1972 Ford Maverick and a 1976 Chevy LUV.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The guys return to a parking lot to swap out the engine in a '74 Jag XJ12.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Mike and David drive a new car every day as they trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour; each day, they'll swap their junk for someone else's and try to make it to the next stop on the tour.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Steve finds a '71 Pontiac T-37 at a junkyard in Idaho; Mike and David take their time reviving a motor that's been sitting for 38 years.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Survival: The LUV Is All You Need!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and Tony Angelo buy a mid-1970s Chevy LUV mini-truck and hit the road, enduring electrical problems, torrential downpours, water in the engine, and floods.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: David and Mike take the show back to its roots, but take things to new heights with a bigger map and a four-door Dart; they'll see how the 2013 version stacks against the '76 318-powered Dodge that started it all.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Project Car Showdown and Roadkill Nights Powered by Dodge!
programme.desc: David and Mike bring their best Dodge project cars out to the M1 Concourse for the annual Roadkill Nights event in Pontiac, Mich.; this time, it's a road course, skidpad and drag racing with seven favorite projects.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Blasphemi takes on HOT ROD Drag Week!
programme.desc: Mike, Tony and the '55 Chevy race for glory in a brutal five-day test for drag-racing, street-driven cars; Blasphemi is known for three things, going fast, being awesome and breaking apart.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The guys want to revive the long-neglected '71 240Z and drive it to SEMA.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: Diesel Swapped Drag Racing Torino Wagon!
programme.desc: Mike and Tony divert from a road trip to accept a drag racing challenge.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Mike and David buy each other their worst automotive nightmares and put them to the test against Steve in a showdown; Finnegan rides high, Freiburger works through some "cosmetic" damage and Dulcich rampages through fire.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The T-Bizzle is an '86 Thunderbird powered by a 302 V8, topped with a 6-71 blower and welded gears; Freiburger and Finnegan take it across the frozen tundra of the northern U.S., on a classic road trip with plenty of fail.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan take a look at Roadkill's Top Project Cars.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan clean out wheels that have been stashed in the garage for far too long by slapping them on a neglected '66 Dodge D100 Utiline truck; they hit the road on a quest to find the perfect 440 for it.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.sub-title: At-Home Build-Off: COVID 350 vs Mini Truck!
programme.desc: The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

programme.title: Roadkill
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
programme.desc: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

programme.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Demon Knight
programme.desc: Ex-soldier Frank Brayker (William Sadler) is the guardian of an ancient key that can unlock tremendous evil; the sinister but charming Collector (Billy Zane) is a demon who wants the key so he can initiate the apocalypse. On the run from wicked mercenaries for almost 90 years, Brayker finally stops in at a boarding house in New Mexico where -- with the help of its quirky residents -- he plans to face off against the Collector and his band of ghouls, preventing them from ever seizing the key.

programme.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday

programme.title: Powering the Future
programme.desc: Dr. M. Sanjayan, lead scientist at The Nature Conservancy, shines a spotlight on America's quest for clean energy. The four-part series addresses the challenge from every angle and cuts through all the rhetoric by establishing a target: identifying a clean, limitless, secure energy supply and a way for it to be delivered. Sanjayan discusses new technologies that could end the dependence on fossil fuels; explains how the natural world can create energy; filters out politics and special interests to reveal statistics on energy waste; and tells of unlikely characters and companies that are leading the way in an energy sea change.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Horse trader Roy Rogers has plans to breed his prize mare with legendary stallion Golden Sovereign. Unfortunately, scheming nightclub owner Brett Scoville (Jack Holt) has his eye on the same stud and steals the horse. Sovereign breaks free, however, and mates with Rogers's mare, eventually producing a spirited colt that Rogers names Trigger. When Sovereign is accidentally killed, Rogers is blamed for the crime, and he and Trigger must escape the law and track down the real killer.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: A year after dealing with a surprise engagement in Father of the Bride, Stanley Banks (Spencer Tracy) and his wife, Ellie (Joan Bennett), are in for another shock when they find their daughter Kay (Elizabeth Taylor) is now pregnant. Not ready to be a grandfather, Stanley keeps quiet while everyone else fawns over the mother-to-be and bothers her about baby names and nursery decorations. Ironically, his silence makes him the person Kay turns to the most for help, which in turn helps him.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: In this rural drama, Sam Tucker (Zachary Scott) is a Texan cotton picker who aspires to run his own farm and create a better life for his family, which includes two kids and the irritable Granny Tucker (Beulah Bondi). Aided by his beautiful wife, Nona (Betty Field), Tucker begins to work a neglected plot of land, but numerous difficulties arise, including bad weather and conflicts with jealous neighbors, making it hard for the Tuckers to get ahead.

programme.title: Our Town
programme.desc: For the residents of Grover's Corners, daily life proceeds at a predictable pace. The milkman (Stuart Erwin) arrives like clockwork, the neighbors perpetually gossip about nothing and children contemplate their future. Two of these children, George (William Holden) and Emily (Martha Scott), fall in love as adults and, despite last-minute nerves, get married. Their happiness does not last, however, as Emily dies during the birth of a child. Returning as a ghost, she ponders her existence.

programme.title: Friendly Persuasion
programme.desc: The patriarch of a peace-loving Quaker family, Jess Birdwell, begins to question his pacifist values when the Civil War moves toward his close-knit Indiana community. Meanwhile, Jess's daughter, Mattie, is in love with a soldier, and her brother, Josh, contemplates picking up arms to defend his home lest he be considered a coward. As Confederate forces draw nearer, the Birdwells must make some difficult, life-altering decisions.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Suche nach einer neuen, vor allem nachhaltigen Energiequelle ist die bislang größte technische Herausforderung. Forscher arbeiten seit Jahren an der Entwicklung eines Fusionsreaktors, der endlos Energie liefern soll, bislang vergebens.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Ob sie wichtige Versorgungsgüter zum Schlachtfeld fliegen, über Kampfeinsätzen schweben oder internationale Missionen unter schwierigsten Bedingungen durchführen: Militärhubschrauber sind für ihre Aufgaben bestens gerüstet.

programme.desc: Im Herzen Nordamerikas liegen die Northern Great Plains. Die Grasweisen scheinen oft endlos, doch die Wildnis ist stark bedroht. Wo einst Herden von Bisons und Gabelböcken grasten, erstreckt sich über weite Gebiete Agrar- oder Farmland.

programme.title: Wenn die Welt innehält - Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur wollen herausfinden, was Küstenstädte zum Sinken bringt. Außerdem sollen Gelder aufgebracht werden, um die Region zukünftig für die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels zu rüsten.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur forschen nach den Folgen des Klimawandels für Küsteninfrastrukturen inklusive Häfen und den Handel. Außerdem wollen sie wissen, wie gut die betroffenen Gebiete vorbereitet sind.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory of Singapore tauchen ab und erforschen die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels auf den Ozean und sammeln Ideen für künstliche Riffe. Sie entdecken eine Korallenart, die resistent gegen den Klimawandel ist.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Länder und Inseln in Südostasien erheben sich zu großen Teilen kaum über den Meeresspiegel. Von einem Anstieg des Meeresspiegels im Zuge der Klimaerwärmung sind sie daher existenziell bedroht. Es kommt bereits zunehmend zu Überflutungen.

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzendes Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter - einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem "Wings & Wheels"-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes sind spektakuläre Flugstunts am Himmel.

programme.title: Wilde Wege

programme.title: Wilde Wege

programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzendes Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter - einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem "Wings & Wheels"-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes sind spektakuläre Flugstunts am Himmel.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im Nordosten Georgiens, an der Grenze zu Russland, führt die Abano-Straße in luftige Höhen. Mit fast 3.000 Metern ist der Abano-Pass die höchste befahrbare Straße im Großen Kaukasus. Sie schlängelt sich an schwindelerregenden Steilhängen empor.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans-Sulawesi Highway ist die Lebensader der viertgrößten Insel Indonesiens und verbindet verschiedene Orte. Traumhafte Strände, turbulente Großstädte oder tiefe Urwälder. Als Busfahrer auf dem Highway braucht man Know-how und starke Nerven.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im äußersten Nordosten Norwegens, der Finnmark, sind die Winter eiskalt und schneereich. Durch die Lage am Arktischen Ozean sind die Straßen anfällig für Schneeverwehungen. Jeder Meter ist eine Herausforderung und eine Fahrt ins Risiko.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Gleich hinter der tschechischen Grenze trifft Action auf Adrenalin und taktisches Denken auf Teamgeist. Beim Gotchaspielen kann man Dampf ablassen, dem Alltag entfliehen und sich dabei gleichzeitig fit halten. Tim Bauer kennt alle 12 Spielfelder.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Im Off-Road Park gelten andere Regeln als im Straßenverkehr. Die Sendung ist geeignet für Menschen, die schon als Kind vom Bagger fahren träumten. Auf einem riesigen Spielplatz werden Tatra-LKWs, Quads und Offroad-Trainer bewegt.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Die Vorstellung, vom Gleitschirm aus die atemberaubende Aussicht auf die Erde zu genießen, fasziniert viele. Fluglehrer Lukas Bader bringt seinen Schülern genau das bei, indem er sie in der notwendigen Theorie für einen Flugschein unterrichtet.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Den Neusser Krieg von 1475 inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Rollenspieler wieder. In der Stadt Zons am Rhein stehen kostümierte Männer mit Schwertern und Lanzen, um diese historische Schlacht wieder auf zu erleben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Die Frightguys sind Fans von Grauen und Grusel - oder kurz dem Horror-Genre. Sie leben mit ihren selbst gemachten Kostümen auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen ihre schönsten Albträume aus, um in die Rollen ihrer schauderhaften Figuren zu schlüpfen.

programme.title: Holzhochhäuser - Die Jagd nach dem Rekord
programme.desc: Globale Skylines im Wandel: Holzhochhäuser, die wie Pflanzen aus der Erde sprießen, erobern die Architekturwelt. Pioniere nutzen innovative Techniken, um aus dem nachwachsenden Rohstoff Holz lebendige Wohnkomplexe zu schaffen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Heute ist die Bauindustrie für einen großen Anteil des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs verantwortlich. Es gibt keine Anzeichen darauf, dass sich dies in naher Zukunft ändern wird. Umso wichtiger werden umweltfreundliche Materialien wie Holz.

programme.title: Gorgona - Europas letzte Gefängnisinsel
programme.desc: Mitten in Europa liegt die Gefängnisinsel Gorgona. Vor Italiens Küste sitzen hier rund hundert Schwerverbrecher ihre Strafen ab. Ihren Alltag verbringen die Straftäter nachts hinter Gefängnismauern und tagsüber mit harter Arbeit auf der Plantage.

programme.title: Russlands Gewalt-Problem

programme.title: Bionik - Die Besten Ideen der Natur

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans, and true fun are the whole point? programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber

The night Damar Hamlin's heart stopped, and millions hung on their every word. Through all of it, their own stories - flourishing in a male-dominated business, juggling single motherhood with a demanding career - stayed off the mic. Until now.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
programme.desc: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Driftin' River
programme.desc: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

programme.title: Return of the Lash
programme.desc: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Panhandle

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Hollywood agent Jack Giamoro (Ben Affleck) has a ruthless dedication to his work and a tendency to neglect his wife, Nina (Rebecca Romijn). Upon discovering that Nina has been sleeping with an up-and-coming actor, Giamoro enrolls in a self-help course and begins keeping a diary. But, when that diary, with its tell-all account of Giamoro's professional and personal turmoil, falls into the hands of freelance writer Barbi Ling (Bai Ling), he struggles to retrieve it and prevent a massive scandal.

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: The Carson City Kid
programme.desc: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
programme.desc: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Lightning Raiders
programme.desc: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: In Old Caliente
programme.desc: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
programme.desc: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: The Red Stallion
programme.desc: Elderly Aggie Curtis is in financial trouble and must come up with cash or sell the horse ranch she runs with her orphaned grandson, Joel. Hoping to save the ranch, Joel decides to train his favorite horse, a stallion named Red, to race. This proves to be no easy task, though -- while Red is speedy, he's also quite unruly. But the Curtises' wealthy neighbor, Moresby, takes an interest in buying Red, and Joel must consider selling his animal pal.

programme.title: Man About Town

programme.desc: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.desc: On the beach near his home, Jimmy (Charles Herbert) finds a bottle that contains a genie named Abu (Joseph Turkel), who magically transports him to the ship of the pirate Blackbeard (Murvyn Vye). The pair spend a few eventful days with Blackbeard, evading capture, accompanied by a girl (Susan Gordon) they rescue, but Jimmy begins to wonder if he'll ever get back home.

But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

programme.title: Stolen Hours

In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace.

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya

programme.title: The Sultan's Daughter

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
programme.desc: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: Scientist Stephen Reinhart travels to a small town where he plans to visit his fiancée Susan Witley and meet her parents. Oddly, when he arrives, the townspeople are unfriendly. At Susan's parents' estate, her father, Nahum, is acting suspiciously and her mother, Letitia, is hidden away in a bedroom. When Stephen and Susan begin investigating the strange behavior in town, they realize that a radioactive meteor is to blame.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Cult of the Damned
programme.desc: An unscrupulous rock star brings decadence and debauchery to a naive young woman's wealthy household.

programme.title: High Spirits
programme.desc: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Based on the life of tap-dancing legend Bill Robinson -- also known as Mr. Bojangles -- the film follows Robinson as he climbs his way up the entertainment ladder from lowly vaudeville performer to one of the greatest black entertainers of his time. programme.title: Convicts
programme.desc: In 1902, Soll (Robert Duvall), a Texas plantation owner who depends on convict labor to keep his farm running, takes a liking to Horace (Lukas Haas), a young boy who works the fields to raise money for his deceased father's headstone. Soll, however, is aging and sinking into senility, making the possibility of Horace ever getting his pay increasingly unlikely. Meanwhile, Soll's relationships with the African-American cons working the farm are complex and informed by both racism and compassion.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Youngblood
programme.desc: An angry Vietnam veteran (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs) leads a Los Angeles street gang in a war on drug dealers.

programme.title: Born Wild
programme.desc: Relocating from California to a small town in Arizona, young Tony (Tom Nardini) arrives at a high school simmering with racial tension. While Tony attempts to cool the conflicts between the local Latino gang and a white group led by the tough-talking Bruce (David Macklin), his efforts aren't met with much regard. With even the school's teachers openly taking sides, it seems that little can be done to avoid an inevitable explosion of hate-fueled violence.

programme.title: Take a Giant Step
programme.desc: After African-American teenager Spence Scott (Johnny Nash) gets expelled from his private school for arguing with a teacher, he turns to his grandmother (Estelle Hemsley) for advice. Spence, who lives in a genteel white area and has mostly white friends, feels like an outsider. He visits a bar in a black neighborhood, where he meets a few prostitutes, which doesn't help. Eventually, Spence starts a friendship with the housekeeper, Christine (Ruby Dee), who tells him her own difficult story.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: A Life of Sin
programme.desc: A South American reporter (Raul Julia) investigates the life of an impoverished Caribbean peasant girl who became a world-famous madam (Miriam Colon).

programme.title: Fires Within
programme.desc: In 1982, Cuban political activist Nestor (Jimmy Smits) is ripped from the arms of his loving wife, Isabel (Greta Scacchi), and thrown in jail for dissidence. Frightened, Isabel flees with their daughter by sea to America. Off the coast of Florida, she meets Sam (Vincent D'Onofrio), a kind fisherman who sees them safely to Miami's Little Havana. Eight years later, Isabel is happy in the arms of Sam -- until a recently freed Nestor reaches Miami in hope of a romantic reunion.

programme.title: Halliday Brand
programme.desc: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

programme.title: More Dead Than Alive
programme.desc: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

programme.title: Gun Fever
programme.desc: After growing up living a life of crime, outlaw Sam Weller (John Lupton) decides to go straight, but neither Sam's father, Trench (Aaron Saxon), nor his thieving cohort, Charlie Whitman (Norman Frederic), take the news well. After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon.

programme.title: The Law Rides Again
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When Bat arrives at a mining town in Bonanza, Colo., to collect $20,000 in earnings from a cattle drive, he discovers the town believes him dead and gave his money to a woman claiming to be his widow.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: The territorial administrator seeks Bat's help in stemming a crime wave in Cheyenne.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Liz Dothan persuades Sam Wade to place her jewelry overnight in the Wells Fargo safe, and remembers the combination as she watches him open it; Hollister's sharp mind and keen observations help him solve the subsequent $20,000 theft.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Jonas Bell is killed in a scuffle with Hollister after a bank clerk is murdered; siblings Noah and Lady Bell conspire to avenge their father targeting Hollister.

programme.title: The Alamo: Thirteen Days to Glory
programme.desc: In 1836, Jim Bowie, Davy Crockett and the Texas rebels make a heroic last stand at the Alamo against the Mexican army of several thousand men led by General Santa Anna.

programme.title: Blood Red
programme.desc: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills.

programme.title: Rebel in Town
programme.desc: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.desc: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: Belle of the Yukon
programme.desc: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

programme.desc: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

programme.desc: Before initiating an undercover investigation in Tombstone, Ariz., Capt. Matt Sloane (George Montgomery) sets out to build a reputation for himself as a ruthless man.
